offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai) — Search the web and convert results to LLM-friendly text block
offerings.pricing: 基于 token 计费；『Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens』；Prototype Development 档 $50 / 1 Billion tokens（0.050/1M tokens），Production Deployment 档 $500 / 11 Billion tokens（0.045/1M tokens）
offerings.price_basis: 按固定 10,000 tokens/次请求机械换算至 Prototype Development（Standard）档 0.050/1M tokens，得 $0.50/1k 请求；Premium 档 0.045/1M tokens 为 $0.45/1k 请求
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10 million free tokens（Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, Non-commercial use only CC-BY-NC）
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（返回 top 5 条结果的 URL、标题与内容，LLM-friendly 文本/JSON）
offerings.note: 『Search the web and return the top five results with their URLs and contents』；无 key 100 RPM / Free key 100 RPM / Premium 1000 RPM；平均延迟 2.5s；计费按输出响应 token 计数（搜索请求固定起价 10,000 tokens）
